name: Distrust Subdomain
body:
Based off of the hatred subdomain.

Associated Domain: Despair

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the feed on hopes power of the despair domain.

Aura of Distrust (Su)

At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of distrust for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level. These rounds need not be consecutive. Enemies within this aura must attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Charisma modifier) or be unable to provide any teamwork benefits. On a failed save, the target may not benefit or provide flanking, aid another or teamwork feats. The effect ends immediately if the creature leaves the aura, you end the aura as a free action, or you expend all rounds of this ability. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and despair effect.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st–murderous command, 3rd-false alibi, 6th-curse of the outcast, 9th–symbol of strife
